info.title: Games Manager API
info.description:
REST API for managing sports games, teams, players, and fields.

## Authentication
Protected routes require an `Authorization` header containing the **base64-encoded username**
of the authenticated user (e.g. `btoa('admin')` ? `YWRtaW4=`).
Obtain a token by calling `POST /auth/login`.

post.summary: Log in and obtain an auth token (no auth required)
post.description:
No authentication required. Validates `username` and `password` against stored users.
Returns a `token` (base64-encoded username) to use as the `Authorization` header on
subsequent requests, along with the user's `role`.

get.description:
Any authenticated user. Admins receive UserDTO[], others receive UserShortDTO[].
Inactive users excluded.

200.description: List of users (shape depends on caller role — see description)

post.summary: Create a new user (no auth required)
post.description:
No authentication required. Creates a new user account.
The `role` field in the request body is ignored — the role is always set to `player` server-side.
The `password` is hashed with bcrypt before storage.

get.summary: Find a user by username (admin or referee only)

401.description: Missing or invalid token, or caller is not admin/referee

get.summary: Find a user by email (admin or referee only)

401.description: Missing or invalid token, or caller is not admin/referee

get.summary: Get a user by ID (any authenticated user)
get.description:
Any authenticated user can call this endpoint.
- **Admin**: receives `UserDTO`.
- **Own profile (non-admin)**: receives `UserShortDTO`.
- **Other user (non-admin)**: returns 403 Forbidden.

200.description: User profile. Admins receive `UserDTO`; own profile receives `UserShortDTO`.

400.description: ID is not a valid number

403.description: Non-admin caller tried to view another user's profile

put.description:
Any authenticated user can call this endpoint.
An admin may update any user. A non-admin user may only update their own profile — the
token's user ID must match the `{id}` path parameter; attempting to update another user
returns 403. Body must include `id` matching the URL parameter; if body `id` and path `{id}`
differ, the endpoint returns 400. Fields `password`, `role`,
and `status` in the body are accepted but `role` and `status` are preserved from the stored
record server-side; only `firstName`, `lastName`, `email`, `username` are updated.

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin and tries to update another user

delete.description:
Requires authentication. An `admin` may soft-delete any user; a non-admin may soft-delete only their own account.
Attempts to delete another user as non-admin return 403.
Sets the user's status to `inactive`.
The user remains in the data store but is excluded from listings and cannot log in.
Admin accounts cannot be deleted.

400.description: Invalid ID or attempt to delete an admin account

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin

patch.description:
Requires `admin` role. Changes the role of the user identified by `{id}`.
Only users currently holding the `player` role can be promoted — attempting to change
the role of an `admin`, `referee`, or `trainer` returns 400.
Valid target roles are `player`, `referee`, `trainer`, and `admin`.

400.description: Invalid ID, invalid role value, or user is not a player

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin

patch.description: Requires `admin` role. Sets the user's status back to `active`, reversing a soft-delete.

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin

get.description:
No authentication required. Returns a short view of all teams (`TeamShortDTO`):
id, name, and sportType only. Does not include player lists or trainer details.

post.description:
Requires `trainer` role. Creates a new team. The authenticated trainer is automatically
set as the team's `trainerId` — the `trainerId` field in the body is ignored.
The new team is initialized with an empty player list.

403.description: Authenticated user is not a trainer

get.summary: Get the teams the authenticated user belongs to (any authenticated user)
get.description:
Any authenticated user can call this endpoint. Returns the full representation of all
teams the authenticated user is listed as a player of, or trainer for (`TeamFullDTO`), with player and
trainer objects resolved. Returns an empty array if the user is not in any team.

200.description: List of teams with resolved players and trainer

get.summary: Get a team by ID (no auth required)
get.description:
No authentication required. Returns the standard representation of a single team (`TeamDTO`)
with raw player IDs and trainerId. Returns 400 if `{id}` is not a valid number,
404 if no team with that ID exists.

put.description:
Requires `trainer` role. Replaces the team's fields with the provided values.
Body must include `id` matching the URL parameter; if body `id` and path `{id}` differ,
returns 400. Body must also include `players` (array of IDs)
and `trainerId`.

403.description: Authenticated user is not a trainer

delete.summary: \"?? NOT TO BE IMPLEMENTED — Delete a team (admin only, for reference only)\"
delete.description:
> **Note for students:** This endpoint is described here for API design completeness only.
> It is **not required** and **will not be graded**. Do not implement it.
> In the current implementation, this route is not registered and requests return `404`.

Requires `admin` role. Permanently removes the team from the data store.

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin

patch.description:
Any authenticated user can call this endpoint. Adds the authenticated user to the team's
player list. The user ID is taken from the auth token — no body is required.
Returns 400 if the user is already a member.

400.description: User is already in the team

patch.description:
Any authenticated user can call this endpoint. Removes the authenticated user from the
team's player list. The user ID is taken from the auth token — no body is required.
Returns 404 if the team does not exist or the user is not a member.

404.description: Team not found or user not in team

get.summary: List upcoming and ongoing games (no auth required)

post.description:
Requires `referee` role. Creates a new game. The authenticated referee is automatically
set as the game's `refereeId` if none is provided in the body. The initial status is
set automatically: if both `fieldId` and `scheduledDate` are present the status becomes
`scheduled`; otherwise it is set to `created`.

403.description: Authenticated user is not a referee

get.summary: Get a game by ID (no auth required)
get.description: No authentication required. Returns the full representation of a single game (`GameDTO`).

put.description:
Requires `referee` role. Replaces the game's fields with the provided values.
Body must include `id` matching the URL parameter; if body `id` and path `{id}` differ,
returns 400. Games in `finished` or `cancelled`
status cannot be updated. For games in `started` status, `fieldId`, `refereeId`,
`homeTeamId`, and `awayTeamId` are locked and cannot be changed.

example.name: Red Dragons vs Blue Eagles — Final

403.description: Authenticated user is not a referee

delete.description:
Requires `admin` role. Permanently removes the game from the data store (hard delete).
The record cannot be recovered.

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin

patch.summary: Set the score of a started game (referee only)
patch.description:
Requires `referee` role. Overwrites the home and away score of a game with the values
from the URL path parameters. The game must be in `started` status — any other status returns 400.

400.description: Game not found, not in started status, or invalid score values

403.description: Authenticated user is not a referee

patch.summary: Update game status (referee, trainer, or admin)
patch.description:
Requires `referee`, `trainer`, or `admin` role. Transitions the game to the requested
status. Allowed transitions:
- `created` ? `cancelled`
- `scheduled` ? `started` (requires `fieldId`, `refereeId`, `homeTeamId`, and `awayTeamId` to all be set)
- `scheduled` ? `cancelled`
- `started` ? `finished`
Any other transition returns 400.

400.description: Invalid or disallowed status transition, or missing prerequisites for starting

401.description: Authenticated user does not have referee, trainer, or admin role

get.description: No authentication required. Returns all fields in the system as a `FieldDTO` array.

post.description: Requires `admin` role. Creates a new field. Both `name` and `location` are required.

400.description: Name or location is missing or invalid

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin

get.summary: Get a field by ID (no auth required)
get.description: No authentication required. Returns the full representation of a single field (`FieldDTO`).

put.description:
Requires `admin` role. Replaces the field's `name` and `location` with the provided values.
Body must include `id` matching the URL parameter; if body `id` and path `{id}` differ,
returns 400.

400.description: Invalid payload (including invalid body shape and body/path ID mismatch)

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin

delete.description:

> It is **not required** and **will not be graded**. Do not implement it.

403.description: Authenticated user is not an admin

bearerToken.name: Authorization
bearerToken.description:
Base64-encoded username. Obtain from `POST /auth/login`.
Example: `Authorization: YWRtaW4=` (base64 of \"admin\")

ErrorResponse.description:
Canonical JSON error shape. Note: current implementation is mixed and may also return plain
text or an empty body on some routes/statuses.

UserLoginDTO.description: Credentials used to authenticate a user

AuthenticatedUserDTO.description: Successful login response containing the auth token and user role

token.description: Base64-encoded username. Pass as the Authorization header value.

EUserStatus.description:
User account status:
- `active` — account is active (default)
- `inactive` — account has been soft-deleted

ERole.description:
User role:
- `admin` — full administrative access
- `player` — default role for regular users
- `referee` — assigned to officiate games
- `trainer` — assigned to coach a team

UserShortDTO.description: Minimal user representation. Returned by GET /users and GET /users/:id for non-admin callers.

UserFullDTO.description:
Full user profile with timestamps. Not currently used by any endpoint in the reverted code,
but kept for documentation purposes.

UserDTO.description:
**Outbound** user representation — never contains a password in responses.
Returned by: GET /users (admin callers), POST /users,
PUT /users/:id, GET /users/username/:username, GET /users/email/:email,
PATCH /users/:id/role/:role.

password.description: Optional — only present in inbound PUT /users/:id body; never returned in outbound responses

NewUserDTO.description: Payload for creating a user (POST /users). Role is always forced to `player`.

UserDBO.description:
**Database object** — shape stored in `data/users.json` (snake_case).
Used internally; never returned directly by the API.

TeamShortDTO.description: Minimal team representation returned by GET /teams

TeamDTO.description:
Standard team representation with raw player IDs and trainerId.
Returned by GET /teams/:id, POST /teams, PUT /teams/:id, PATCH /teams/:id/join, PATCH /teams/:id/leave.

TeamFullDTO.description:
Full team representation with **resolved** player and trainer objects.
Returned only by GET /teams/own.

TeamDBO.description:
**Database object** — shape stored in `data/teams.json` (snake_case).
Used internally; never returned directly by the API.

EGameStatus.description:
Lifecycle status of a game (all lowercase):
- `created` — initial state, no field or date assigned
- `scheduled` — field and date are set (auto-assigned on create/update)
- `started` — game is in progress
- `finished` — game has ended
- `cancelled` — game was cancelled

**Allowed transitions:**
- `created` ? `cancelled`
- `scheduled` ? `started` | `cancelled`
- `started` ? `finished`

GameShortDTO.description:
Minimal game representation returned by `GET /games`.
Only includes fields useful for listing; no scores, no timestamps.

GameDTO.description: Full game representation returned by most game endpoints.

NewGameDTO.description: Payload for creating a game (POST /games). All fields are optional.

GameDBO.description:
**Database object** — shape stored in `data/games.json` (snake_case).
Used internally; never returned directly by the API.

FieldDTO.description: Field representation returned by field endpoints.

FieldDBO.description:
**Database object** — shape stored in `data/fields.json` (snake_case).
Used internally; never returned directly by the API.
